caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a person standing upright in the center, wearing a long robe in shades of white, blue, and yellow, with a greenish tint, and a crown on their head. The figure has long black hair and holds an object in their right hand that appears to be an ornate staff or a spiked object, colored yellow and outlined in black. The left arm is bent, with the hand near the chest. Behind the figure, on the left side of the image, there is a bell-shaped object colored in green and outlined in black, topped with a cross. The background consists of a mix of light brown, pink, orange, green, and yellow hues, suggesting a wood texture with some rough areas along the seems, and two long green draped curtains hang down on both the top left and right corners. The image is painted within the borders of what appears to be an irregularly cut rectangle of wood, with the outer edges rough and unpainted. The entire composition sits centered on a plain, off-white background, with the drawing taking up the central vertical area of the page.
title: Santo (Nuestra-Sonora di la Luze)
